seed_all_random_engines: seed all random engines including numpy, torch, and random with a given integer seed value
get_optimizer_discriminator_path: get the discriminator optimizer path by replacing _opt.pth with _opt_disc.pth in the file path
path_mkdir: create a directory at the given path with parent directories if they do not exist
use_seed_context_manager: use the use_seed class as a context manager to temporarily set and restore random seed state
use_seed_decorator: decorate a function with use_seed to wrap its execution with a temporary random seed
